gloss: main unlucky year; principal calamity year

definitions.gloss: main unlucky year; principal calamity year
definitions.explanation: The central and most critical year in the yakudoshi cycle, when one is believed to be most susceptible to misfortune. The ages differ for men and women.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{本厄|ほんやく}だから{気|き}をつけよう。
examples.english: This year is my main unlucky year, so I should be careful.

examples.japanese: {本厄|ほんやく}を{迎|むか}えて、{厄払|やくばら}いに{行|い}ってきた。
examples.english: Having reached my main unlucky year, I went to have a purification ritual performed.

examples.japanese: {男性|だんせい}の{大厄|たいやく}は{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}で42{歳|さい}で、この{本厄|ほんやく}の{年|とし}には{大|おお}きな{決断|けつだん}を{避|さ}けるべきだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: The great calamity year for men is age 42 by traditional counting, and it is said that one should avoid making major decisions during this main unlucky year.

notes:
Part of the {厄年|やくどし} (unlucky year) system in Japanese folk belief. The {厄年|やくどし} cycle consists of three years: {前厄|まえやく} (the year before), {本厄|ほんやく} (the main year), and {後厄|あとやく} (the year after). {本厄|ほんやく} is the peak year when misfortune is considered most likely.

The main {厄年|やくどし} ages (by traditional counting, {数|かぞ}え{年|どし}) are:
- Men: 25, 42 ({大厄|たいやく}), 61
- Women: 19, 33 ({大厄|たいやく}), 37, 61

Many Japanese visit shrines for {厄払|やくばら}い (purification rites) during their {本厄|ほんやく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本厄|ほんやく}を{迎|むか}える: to reach one's main unlucky year
- {本厄|ほんやく}の{厄払|やくばら}い: purification for the main unlucky year
- {本厄|ほんやく}の{年|とし}: the year of one's main yakudoshi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前厄|まえやく}: the year before the main unlucky year — considered a warning period
- {後厄|あとやく}: the year after the main unlucky year — misfortune is fading but caution remains
- {大厄|たいやく}: the greatest unlucky year — the most feared year (42 for men, 33 for women)
- {厄年|やくどし}: unlucky year — the general term for the entire yakudoshi system
